name: A morning in the Maasai village
led_by: A Maasai guide from the camp
live: Your guide walks you into the village and introduces you by name. Songs, homes and stories are shared on the village's own terms, and questions are welcome.
good_to_know: Ask before taking photographs, and let your guide introduce you.
alt: A Maasai guide in a red shuka standing beside a safari vehicle under a tree
